When I finish a series whose status is Completed, it disappears from Want to Read by the next day, which is great. But when I catch up on an ongoing manga (I've read every chapter on the server), it never leaves Want to Read. Weeks later it is still in the list.

Current behaviour:
A fully read series whose publication status is Ongoing (or Hiatus) stays in Want to Read indefinitely.

Expected behaviour:
Once I've read everything in a series it should drop off Want to Read the same way completed series do, whatever its publication status.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Star an ongoing series so it is in Want to Read.
2. Mark the whole series as read.
3. Wait for the nightly tasks to run.
4. Open Want to Read: the series is still listed.
